events.name: Bash
events.head: Check push hold, ancestry and log state
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git log -1 --format=%B d5a2dcea | head -20; echo ---; git merge-base --is-ancestor 512c734 origin/main && echo ANCESTOR || echo NOT; git rev-parse --short origin/main; git log --oneline origin/main..main | wc -l; echo ---; grep -n -i "publish held\|push held\|hold\|lifted" workshop-plan/coord/LOG.md | tail -15; ls app/scripts | grep -i probe-guides

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read hold context
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git show -s --format=%B d5a2dcea | cut -c1-600; echo ---; tail -6 workshop-plan/coord/LOG.md | cut -c1-400; echo; grep -n "2026-10-06\|2026-10-1[01]" workshop-plan/coord/LOG.md | cut -c1-250 | tail; ls /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md 2>&1; grep -n -i "held\|hold" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -5 | cut -c1-300

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read full T-148 commit message
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git cat-file -p d5a2dcea | sed -n '6,12p' | fold -w 200 | head -12; grep -rn -i "no push\|stop push\|hold.*push\|push.*hold\|do not push" workshop-plan/coord/LOG.md /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -5 | cut -c1-300

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect probe-guides usage and servers
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; sed -n 1,40p scripts/probe-guides.mjs | cut -c1-200; grep -n "process.env\|argv" scripts/probe-guides.mjs | head; lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -n -P | grep -E ":43[0-9]{2}|:3000" | awk '{print $1,$2,$9}'

events.text: Checking guides with probe-guides now; first confirming a local server is up.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check dev server and debug guides route
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" --max-time 20 http://localhost:4322/debug/guides; ls src/app/debug/guides/; grep -n "searchParams\|only\|ids" src/app/debug/guides/*.tsx | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run probe-guides on the 8 guides
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; for g in s5-webinar-stages s5-challenge-stages s5-rsp-stages s6-sms s4-challenge s4-rsp s2-tantra-pro-funnel s1-overview; do echo "== $g"; timeout 280 node scripts/probe-guides.mjs "http://localhost:4322/debug/guides?only=$g" 2>&1 | tail -3 | cut -c1-250; done
